issues.t: Passenger airbag inflator can rupture (Takata recall)
issues.sym: No warning before a crash. If the front passenger airbag deploys, its inflator can burst and throw metal fragments.
issues.why: These Yaris models use Takata passenger airbag inflators that break down after years of heat and humidity. Toyota recalls 16V-340, 17V-006, 18V-024, 18V-025 and 19V-741 replace them, depending on the car.
issues.next: Treat this as urgent. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls or with a Toyota dealer and get the free replacement. Keep the front passenger seat empty until it is done if you can.

issues.t: Clear coat and paint peeling
issues.sym: The clear coat turns cloudy, then flakes off in sheets, most often on the roof and hood, then on doors, pillars and the hatch. Blue, red and silver cars are reported most.
issues.why: The factory clear coat on many 2007-2008 Yaris models lost its bond to the color coat after a few years of sun. It is the most reported problem for these years.
issues.next: Wash and wax the car to slow it down and park in shade when you can. Once it starts peeling, the only lasting fix is sanding and repainting the panel. Ask Toyota for goodwill help, though most owners report being turned down.

issues.t: Driver's power window switch can overheat (recall)
issues.sym: The driver's window switch feels sticky or hot, stops working, or smells like burning plastic.
issues.why: The master window switch could short and overheat because it was not lubricated evenly at the factory. Recall 12V-491 covers 2007-2008 models and recall 15V-689 covers 2007-2010 models.
issues.next: If the switch gets hot or smells, stop using it and park outdoors. A Toyota dealer greases or replaces the switch for free.

issues.t: Front seat may not stay locked in place (recall)
issues.sym: The front seat may slide on its track, or feel like it does not latch firmly after you adjust it.
issues.why: Springs in the seat track lock can break, so the seat may not stay locked in a crash. Recall 14V-169 fixes it.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 14V-169 and have it done. Make sure the seat clicks firmly into place after every adjustment.

issues.t: Driver airbag can be disabled by a damaged steering cable (recall)
issues.sym: The airbag warning light comes on, and the horn or steering wheel buttons may stop working.
issues.why: The flat ribbon cable in the steering column that connects the driver's airbag can wear through as the wheel turns. Recall 14V-168 replaces it.
issues.next: Get the free recall repair. Do not ignore an airbag light, because the airbag may not deploy in a crash.

issues.t: Seat belt pretensioner can start a fire after a crash (recall)
issues.sym: No warning in normal driving. In a crash that fires the front seat belt pretensioners, the hot gas can ignite nearby sound insulation.
issues.why: Recall 09V-031 covers early Yaris models where insulation sat too close to the pretensioner exhaust.
issues.next: Have a Toyota dealer confirm recall 09V-031 was done.

issues.t: Load capacity label missing or wrong, 2007-2010 (recalls)
issues.sym: The tire and loading information label on the door pillar is missing or has wrong figures.
issues.why: Several recalls (09V-223, 10V-035 and 10V-036) fixed missing or incorrect load capacity labels, which could lead an owner to overload the car.
issues.next: Ask a dealer for a correct label. Don't load the car past its rated capacity.

issues.t: Squeal from the drive belt at startup
issues.sym: A short screech or squeal from the engine bay right after a cold start, which may fade as the engine warms up.
issues.why: Toyota found the factory drive belt tension on these Yaris models could let the belt slip at startup and issued bulletin T-SB-0012-15 with a new tension specification.
issues.next: Have a shop check belt condition and set the tension to Toyota's updated spec. Replace the belt if it is cracked or glazed.

issues.t: Musty or urine-like smell from the A/C vents
issues.sym: A sour, musty or "urine" smell from the vents when you first turn on the A/C or fan.
issues.why: Mold and bacteria grow on the damp A/C evaporator, especially if the cabin air filter is dirty or the drain is slow. Toyota covers the causes in bulletin T-TT-0051-10.
issues.next: Replace the cabin air filter and have the evaporator cleaned with a foam treatment. Switching the A/C off a minute before you park helps it dry out.

issues.t: Water on the passenger floor from a blocked A/C drain
issues.sym: Wet carpet on the front passenger side, water dripping from under the dash, or a damp smell, usually after using the A/C.
issues.why: The A/C evaporator drain tube can clog with debris or even insect nests, so condensation backs up into the cabin. Toyota has several bulletins on it, including T-SB-0033-14 and T-TT-0468-17.
issues.next: Have the drain tube cleared; it is a quick job. Dry the carpet fully to prevent mold. A dealer can fit Toyota's insect-proof drain tip.

issues.t: Power steering assist can cut out (recall)
issues.sym: The steering suddenly gets heavy, mostly noticeable at low speed or when parking, and a power steering warning may show.
issues.why: A relay in the electric power steering control module could short and switch off steering assist. Recall 13V-292 covers 2012 Yaris models.
issues.next: Hold the wheel firmly and steer with more effort to get somewhere safe. Have the free recall repair done.

issues.t: Headliner may not protect in a crash (recall, Puerto Rico cars)
issues.sym: No symptom. Affects cars originally sold in Puerto Rico.
issues.why: The headliner on some Puerto Rico market Yaris models did not meet the head-impact protection standard. Recall 15V-134 replaces it.
issues.next: If your car came from Puerto Rico, check the VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Check engine light with code P219A from low compression
issues.sym: Check engine light with code P219A (cylinder air-fuel imbalance). The engine may idle rough or misfire.
issues.why: Toyota bulletin T-TT-0411-16 covers early 2014-built engines where a compression test shows a weak cylinder, which upsets the air-fuel balance.
issues.next: Have a shop read the code and run a compression test. If compression is low on early engine serial numbers, ask the dealer about the bulletin repair.

issues.t: Front strut mount bearing can break (recall)
issues.sym: A clunk or knock from the front suspension over bumps, or the steering feeling loose.
issues.why: High loads can damage the front strut mount bearing, which could let the strut rod separate. Recall 16V-367 replaces the bearings.
issues.next: Have the free recall done soon. If you hear heavy clunking, slow down and get it inspected.

issues.t: Rear axle bearing bolts may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: Possibly a rattle or clunk from the rear wheels, or no warning at all.
issues.why: Bolts holding the rear axle hub bearings may not have been tightened properly, which can damage the brakes or lock the wheel. Recall 15V-098 checks and tightens them.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 15V-098 and have it done.

issues.t: Side airbags may not deploy from corroded door wiring (recall)
issues.sym: The airbag warning light may come on.
issues.why: Wiring for the side airbag sensors inside the doors can crack and corrode, so the side and curtain airbags may not deploy properly. Recall 19V-319 covers these cars.
issues.next: Get the free recall repair. Don't ignore an airbag light.

issues.t: Brake pedal vibration from uneven lug nut torque
issues.sym: A shudder or pulsing in the brake pedal or steering wheel when braking, often after tires were rotated or changed.
issues.why: Toyota bulletin T-SB-0313-17 found that lug nuts tightened unevenly, often with an impact gun, can distort the brake rotors.
issues.next: Ask the shop to tighten lug nuts by hand with a torque wrench in a star pattern. If the vibration stays, the rotors may need resurfacing or replacing.

issues.t: Brake groan or squeak after a dealer pad replacement
issues.sym: A groan or squeak while braking in different conditions, after the brake pads were replaced at a dealer.
issues.why: Toyota bulletin T-TT-0636-20 covers noise from some replacement brake pads installed under its Toyota Complete Maintenance Care line.
issues.next: Go back to the dealer and mention the bulletin; a different pad is usually installed.

issues.t: Load capacity label missing or wrong, 2016-2019 (recalls)
issues.sym: The loading information label on the door pillar is wrong, does not account for accessories, or has faded and can't be read.
issues.why: Recalls 16V-236, 19V-503 and 19V-244 replace incorrect or illegible load capacity labels, which could lead to overloading.
issues.next: Ask a dealer for the free replacement label and keep loads within the rated capacity.

issues.t: Spare tire may be underinflated (recall)
issues.sym: You may find the temporary spare is low or flat when you need it.
issues.why: Some spare tires left the factory below the specified pressure. Recall 17V-295 covers them.
issues.next: Check the spare's pressure now and fill it to the value on its label. The dealer will inspect it for free.

issues.t: A/C stops blowing cold
issues.sym: The A/C blows warm or only cool air, sometimes after a loud noise from the compressor. Some owners report repeat failures.
issues.why: Refrigerant leaks and failed compressors are reported, including repeat compressor failures on a 2017 Yaris iA. Toyota bulletin T-TT-0520-19 warns that the real leak source is often missed, causing repeat repairs.
issues.next: Have the A/C system leak-tested with dye before recharging it. If the compressor failed under warranty, keep records in case it happens again.

issues.t: Rear brake squeal on Mazda-built models
issues.sym: A squeal or squeak from the rear brakes when slowing down.
issues.why: Toyota bulletin T-SB-0007-20 covers rear brake noise on the Mazda-built Yaris iA, Yaris Sedan and 2020 Yaris Hatchback and calls for updated parts.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to check the bulletin; the fix is updated rear brake parts.

issues.t: Touchscreen reboots or goes black in cold weather
issues.sym: On the Yaris iA, the center screen restarts on its own or stays black on cold mornings.
issues.why: Toyota bulletin T-SB-0051-18 covers a software fault in the iA's infotainment unit that shows up in cold temperatures.
issues.next: Ask a dealer for the software update in the bulletin.

issues.t: Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: The engine runs rough, the check engine light comes on, the car won't start, or it stalls while driving.
issues.why: The low-pressure fuel pump in the tank can have an impeller that cracks and jams. Recall 21V-617 replaces the pump on 2019-2020 Yaris models.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the free pump replacement done. If the car stalls, get to the shoulder safely and have it towed.

issues.t: Hard starting with lean or low fuel pressure codes
issues.sym: The engine is slow to start or the check engine light comes on with codes P0171, P0174 or P0087.
issues.why: Toyota bulletin TSB000923 covers hard starts and these codes on many 2014-2020 Toyotas, usually tied to low fuel delivery.
issues.next: Have the codes read and the fuel pressure tested. Make sure the fuel pump recall is done first, as it can cause the same symptoms.

issues.t: Power window switch stops working
issues.sym: One or more windows won't go up or down from the switch.
issues.why: Owners of 2019 Yaris sedans report failed window switches at around 40,000 miles.
issues.next: Check the fuse first, then have the switch tested and replaced.

issues.t: Paint peeling on newer cars
issues.sym: Paint flakes off a panel on a fairly new car.
issues.why: Owners report paint peeling on 2019 Yaris sedans at low mileage.
issues.next: Photograph the damage and ask a Toyota dealer to inspect it under the corrosion and paint coverage while the car is still under warranty.
